name: ASBO Matrix
description: All Star bulk quantity pricing matrix and cart-synced single-product quantity controls for WooCommerce product templates.
changelog:
0.2.0

  • Adds the All Star Single Product Quantity block to the All Star Embroidery block group.
  • The displayed quantity is the amount currently in the cart for the selected variation and decoration.
  • Plus and minus update the cart automatically, eliminating the separate Add to Cart click.
  • Works inside WooCommerce Add to Cart + Options (Beta) and follows its selected variation.
  • Matrix products retain production ASBO quantity-tier pricing; products without a matrix retain native WooCommerce pricing.
